raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 11
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread the IMFDB Westworld Season 1 page and incorrectly concluded that the Man in Black (Ed Harris—the director of Pollock) used a Remington Model 1875. This conflicted with earlier, correctly sourced indications that he carries a custom LeMat revolver. The error came from conflating the general list of revolvers on the page (including Remington 1875 used by other characters) with the specific weapon of the Man in Black, without verifying the relevant captions/sections.
